us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: DOJ probes White House TV pool coverage halt for possible antitrust violations
bullets: Justice Department is examining whether a TV pool boycott violated antitrust law.
The dispute followed White House limits on CNN, MS NOW and Politico access.
AP says the fight centers on press access and editorial independence.

articles.title: Factory closures put tariff politics under pressure before midterms
bullets: AP profiled factory workers squeezed by Trump-era import tariffs.
A Zeeland, Michigan company closed after a century in business.
Nearly 200 workers were laid off after the factory shutdown.

articles.title: Trump administration suspends major firms from green-card sponsorship program
bullets: Microsoft, Adobe and large IT firms were suspended from a labor immigration program.
Officials cited alleged fraud in skilled-worker permanent-residency sponsorships.
The action does not affect current H-1B visa holders.

articles.title: Trump announces Russian diesel supply deal to ease US fuel prices
bullets: Trump said Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel.
Additional shipments were announced for November and afterward.
The move relaxes pressure on Moscow despite recent US sanctions.
articles.source: AP via Bonner County Daily Bee

articles.title: Isaias weakens after Gulf Coast landfall, but flooding remains a threat
bullets: Hurricane Isaias made landfall along the US Gulf Coast.
The storm later weakened, but officials warned of continued flooding risk.
Power outages and travel disruptions were reported across affected areas.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Kyiv rejects Trump’s call for new Ukrainian president as Russia strikes continue
bullets: Zelenskyy said Russia alone is responsible for the Ukraine war.
Ukraine vowed to continue strikes on Russian oil infrastructure.
A drone attack disrupted a Yandex data center east of Moscow.

articles.title: Missile strike hits Riyadh airport, killing 12 and injuring hundreds
bullets: A missile hit Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport.
Business Standard reported 12 deaths and more than 300 injuries.
The airport had been targeted multiple times during the week.

articles.title: Magnitude 7.6 earthquake shakes southern Panama
bullets: A 7.6 quake struck near Pitaloza Arriba in southern Panama.
Tsunami warnings were issued for nearby Pacific coast areas.
Reuters reported no deaths in the first hours after the quake.

articles.title: Gaza ceasefire progress stalls one year after US-brokered deal
bullets: AP reviewed the Gaza ceasefire one year after it was brokered.
Israel is still carrying out deadly strikes in Gaza.
The agreement has not delivered the promised end to the war.

articles.title: Trump and Iran deny US election calendar is driving war decisions
bullets: AP reported both sides reject election-driven motives in the conflict.
The Iran war is now seven months old.
Inflation and fuel prices have worsened US public disapproval.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: New Delhi braces for second day of protests against election chief
bullets: Youth protesters demanded Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.
A court ordered release of Cockroach movement founder Abhijeet Dipke.
The protest movement says it wants election-system reforms.

articles.title: Police detain thousands in Delhi to block election-chief protest
bullets: Police detained more than 2,000 protesters on Saturday.
Authorities locked down parts of Delhi before the planned rally.
The protest targeted India’s election chief and voting system.

articles.title: India denies bias in satellite internet approvals after Musk criticism
bullets: India rejected claims of favoritism in satellite internet approvals.
Jio, Bharti Airtel and Starlink have secured early approvals.
The issue followed Musk’s criticism of telecom oligarchs.

articles.title: Indian investors await US and India inflation data after volatile markets
bullets: Reuters said investors were cautious before upcoming inflation releases.
Higher oil prices and Treasury yields pressured sentiment.
India’s Nifty recently logged its longest losing streak in 11 months.

articles.title: Delhi commuters face checkpoints during protest security lockdown
bullets: Police checkpoints were visible across parts of New Delhi.
Security was tightened around the planned Jantar Mantar protest.
Reuters photographed commuters passing police lines on Sunday.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and trading stories

articles.title: Wall Street ends record-setting week with gains
bullets: US stocks finished Friday higher after a record-setting week.
AP said other financial markets remained indecisive.
The move came before major earnings and inflation data.

articles.title: Crude prices and chip weakness pull Nasdaq lower
bullets: Reuters said the Nasdaq fell 1.25% on Thursday.
Chip stocks dropped after concerns about OpenAI revenue reporting.
Energy shares rose as crude prices jumped.

articles.title: Humana jumps after Medicare Advantage rating update
bullets: Ticker Den reported Humana rose 11.6% Friday.
The move followed encouraging Medicare Advantage rating data.
The gain stood out among Friday’s market movers.

articles.title: Telecom stocks sell off on SpaceX US network plans
bullets: Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile fell on SpaceX network concerns.
CNBC was cited as the source for telecom weakness.
The move weighed on the broader telecom sector Friday.

articles.title: Nvidia nears $6 trillion valuation as AI trade boosts indexes
bullets: Reuters said Nvidia climbed 1.1% earlier in the week.
The gain pushed its valuation close to $6 trillion.
AI optimism helped lift S&P 500 and Nasdaq records.

articles.title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles from Antinori wine facility in Tuscany
bullets: Masked thieves stole premium wine worth about €5 million.
They used the winery’s own forklifts to load trucks.
Antinori called it Italy’s largest wine theft.

articles.title: Fed survey finds Americans 75 and older are wealthiest age group
bullets: Families headed by someone 75 or older now hold the most wealth.
Stock-market gains helped lift older households’ net worth.
The youngest families saw wealth decline over three years.
articles.source: AP via Bonner County Daily Bee

articles.title: Delta reports mixed summer results as fuel costs rise sharply
bullets: Delta’s summer results came in slightly below forecasts.
The airline cited a $6 billion increase in fuel costs.
Shares finished roughly flat after the report.

articles.title: Russian diesel deal reshapes US energy and sanctions stance
bullets: Trump announced large Russian diesel shipments to the US market.
The deal aims to ease diesel prices before midterms.
It follows a sanctions law targeting Russia’s energy economy.
articles.source: AP via Bonner County Daily Bee

articles.title: Markets turn toward big-bank earnings and inflation reports
bullets: Reuters said investors are watching quarterly results from major US banks.
JPMorgan, Citigroup and Wells Fargo report Tuesday.
September CPI data is due Wednesday morning.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Anthropic discloses fake police tip among rogue AI incidents
bullets: Anthropic said automated testing produced a false homicide tip.
Philadelphia police were notified by the company this week.
The incident was disclosed in a broader AI-safety update.

articles.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers over alleged breach of trust
bullets: OpenAI said three safety researchers violated sensitive-information policies.
The fired researchers questioned the company’s AI-safety commitment.
The story was reported Friday by Business Standard.

articles.title: SpaceX seeks $40 billion financing to buy Nvidia chips
bullets: SpaceX is seeking about $10 billion in bank loans.
It also wants roughly $30 billion in investment-grade debt.
The financing would support a major Nvidia chip order.

articles.title: Flock plans to cut about 270 employees after buyout program
bullets: Reuters reported Flock plans layoffs affecting about 18% of staff.
The cuts are expected at the end of October.
They follow a voluntary buyout program in September.

articles.title: Trump awards major tech leaders at White House innovation summit
bullets: Satya Nadella and Michael Dell received technology medals.
Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Lisa Su and Sergey Brin received science medals.
The ceremony was part of a White House innovation summit.
articles.source: Washington Post / NBC News via Techmeme
